prompt: Make up a children's bedtime story about Elsa getting icy spiderman powers.
response: Once upon a time, in the magical land of Arendelle, Elsa discovered a mysterious spiderweb made of ice. As she touched it, she felt a surge of power and soon found herself with new icy Spider-Man abilities. She could shoot freezing webs and climb icy walls. With her new powers, she set out to protect her kingdom from villains and keep the peace. Elsa's icy spider powers made her a unique and formidable hero.
